title: Maintenance Scripts
lede: A few scripts help with stats, recovery, and development.
body:
At a glance
  • Backfill stats and sync durations.
  • Recover projects from disk.
  • Install hooks and a dev helper.

Data maintenance

  • Backfill / sync — recompute stats and durations.
  • Recover — rebuild project state from files on disk.

Development

Hook installers and a dev helper streamline local development. See Testing & Verification.
